# API reference

Versioned REST API under `/api/v1`. Interactive documentation is served at `/api/docs`;
the machine-readable document is [openapi.json](openapi.json).

- **Authentication:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets an httpOnly session cookie (a JWT backed by a
  revocable server-side session). The browser reaches the API only through the Next.js same-origin proxy.
- **Authorisation:** the *Access* column is the permission checked in code (`app/core/rbac.py`);
  see [the role matrix](../security/rbac.md). Every data query is additionally filtered to the
  caller's region scope (India / UAE).
- **Errors:** `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`. List endpoints are paginated
  (`page`, `page_size`) and return `{items, total, page, page_size}`.

53 operations.
